request.style: English, male baritone voice, upright bass, brushed drums, upright piano, tenor saxophone, smoky ballad mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The LORD spoke the word to me that day
Take a large tablet and write with care
Write with an ordinary stylus
Belonging to Maher-shalal-hash-baz

[Chorus]
I took reliable witnesses for myself
Uriah the priest stood there
Zechariah son of Jeberechiah
He was there when the truth was told

[Verse]
Before the boy knows to say father
Or knows how to call out mother
The wealth of Damascus will go
Spent and carried away

[Chorus]
I took reliable witnesses for myself
Uriah the priest stood there
Zechariah son of Jeberechiah
He was there when the truth was told

[Bridge]
The spoil of Samaria will be gone
Before the king of Assyria
The name is written on the stone
The witness stands in the light

[Chorus]
I took reliable witnesses for myself
Uriah the priest stood there
Zechariah son of Jeberechiah
He was there when the truth was told

[Outro]
Zechariah son of Jeberechiah
Reliable witness for the truth
